method: Paired by scenario: each arm’s mean over its three trials of a scenario, the difference averaged over scenarios, with a 95% bootstrap interval over scenarios (10,000 resamples, seed 20261113) and an exact two-sided sign-flip test over the scenarios whose arms differ. Pass rate covers all 43 scenarios; the review mean covers the 19 scenarios with a rubric. passExSpeed leaves speed-sensitive failures out, which favors the arm that had them, so it bounds rather than estimates.
multipleTests: Ten tests (five comparisons, two endpoints). With Holm’s correction the smallest p-value would need to be below 0.005.
speedSensitiveRule: A failure is speed-sensitive when it hit the hard ceiling, or when a stop triggered by elapsed time (the craftbook stale no-write repair loop, or the retry loop’s stall or long path) cut off a model turn that was still running: the daemon logged that turn as stopped within 20 seconds of the harness’s stop. Attempt-counted stops never count, whatever was running.
